The Bluejays, led by seventh-year head coach [[Greg McDermott]], played their home games at the [[CenturyLink Center Omaha]], as members of the [[Big East Conference]]. They finished the season 25–10, 10–8 in [[2016–17 Big East Conference men's basketball season|Big East play]] to finish in a four-way tie for third place. In the [[2017 Big East men's basketball tournament|Big East tournament]], they defeated [[2016–17 Providence Friars men's basketball team|Providence]] and [[2016–17 Xavier Musketeers men's basketball team|Xavier]] before losing to [[2016–17 Villanova Wildcats men's basketball team|Villanova]] in the championship game. They received an at-large bid to the [[2017 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]] as a No. 6 seed in the Midwest region. There they lost in the first round to No. 11-seeded [[2016–17 Rhode Island Rams men's basketball team|Rhode Island]]. ==Previous season== The [[2015–16 Creighton Bluejays men's basketball team|Bluejays]] finished the [[2015–16 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2015–16 season]] 20–15, 9–9 in [[2015–16 Big East Conference men's basketball season|Big East play]] to finish in sixth place in conference. They lost to [[2015–16 Seton Hall Pirates men's basketball team|Seton Hall]] in the quarterfinals of the [[2016 Big East men's basketball tournament|Big East tournament]]. They received an invitation to the [[2016 National Invitation Tournament|National Invitation Tournament]] where they beat [[2015–16 Alabama Crimson Tide men's basketball team|Alabama]] in the first round and [[2015–16 Wagner Seahawks men's basketball team|Wagner]] in the second round before losing to [[2015–16 BYU Cougars men's basketball team|BYU]] in the quarterfinals. ==Preseason== Prior to the season, Creighton was picked to finish third in a poll of Big East coaches.{{Cite web|url=http://www.bigeast.com/news/2016/10/10/MBB_1010164924.aspx|title=Villanova Picked Unanimously Again To Win In Preseason Coaches' Poll|website=Big East Conference|language=en|access-date=2017-02-08}} [[Maurice Watson Jr.]] was selected to the preseason All-Big East first team.
